import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter

print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # bottom row = last row containing any cell of that component? Use global max per color present... safer: anchored via bl-chain with bottom-of-grid support.
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False; moved=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w-2,-1,-1):
                c=g[i][j]
                if c==bgc: continue
                if j+1>=w: continue
                if g[i][j+1]!=bgc: continue  # not yet open
                bl=i+1<=h-1 and g[i+1][max(j-1,0)]==c  # bl in input; ignore if below is outside
                if bl: continue
                if j+1<w and out[i][j+1]==bgc:  # dest open in working copy
                    out[i][j]=bgc; out[i][j+1]=c; moved[i][j]=True; changed=True
    return out

        d=[(i,j,A[i][j],o[i][j],B[i][j]) for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(len(A[0])) if o[i][j]!=B[i][j]]
        print(d[:15])

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w-2,-1,-1):
            if g[i][j]==bg: continue
            # moves right 1 if cell is unsupported: neither directly below nor diagonally down-left is same color
            if i+1<h and (g[i+1][j]==g[i][j] or g[i+1][j-1]==g[i][j]): continue
            if j+1<w and g[i][j+1]!=g[i][j]: continue   # blocked by non-same-color cell ahead
            out[i][j]=bg; out[i][j+1]=g[i][j]
    return out
for p in (1,2,3):
    A=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; B=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    o=f(A); print(p,o==B)
    if o!=B:
        d=[(i,j,A[i][j],o[i][j],B[i][j]) for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(len(A[0])) if o[i][j]!=B[i][j]]
        print(d[:15])
